subject: planner: align index range estimation with index columns (#66294)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (planner scope). Change projects/prunes execution ranges that include appended handle dimensions down to index-definition dimensions before calling `cardinality.GetRowCountByIndexRanges`, preventing a range-dimension vs idxCols mismatch panic in the partial-stats (missing index stats + column stats available) path. Added a regression test to force the vulnerable branch; no later upstream/master changes found for `pkg/planner/core/stats.go` after this commit.
